name: M5.PhysicalBridge.packed_divisibility
statement: ∀ (w T d : ℕ) (r : Fin w → Fin T), d ∣ T → ((∀ a ∈ M5.Packing.packedSupport r, d ∣ a) ↔ ∀ i, d ∣ (r i).val)
guidance: Unfold packedSupport membership and packedValue. Since d divides T it divides occurrenceTag*r period term; divisibility of a sum then equals divisibility of residue. Repeated residues and empty index types remain allowed. Return tactic lines without a leading by; preserve exact target.
